description: Ask Intakra to find companies that fit, from a short description, an industry, a size range, a country, or up to 5 of your customers' domains. Suggestions show up in Intakra (and list_suggestions) and never count toward your plan until approved. Ask the user before calling. Runs in the background; a few requests a day at most.

country.description: Two letter country code, for example US

description.description: For example "logistics software companies in Texas"

lookalike_domains.description: Up to 5 customer domains to find lookalikes of
